issues.issue: Is the new evidence admissible under s. 110(4) and may the RAD rely on it?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant filed new evidence and asks the RAD to set aside the RPD decision and find him a Convention refugee.
issues.result_quote: Based on the new evidence, the RAD will substitute the decision of the RPD.

issues.issue: Is the Appellant a Convention refugee because of persecution for his conversion to Christianity?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant fears persecution in Iran for converting to Christianity; RPD found him not credible on identity as convert.
issues.result_quote: The RAD is satisfied that if the Appellant were to return to Iran, he would be persecuted on account of his conversion to Christianity.
